report_reviews.scope_depth_and_novelty: Answers the finite initialization, append, page remap, reuse, RESTORE, source-pool and queue-lifetime question with four alternatives and capacity/fallback limits. R928/R931's SGLang selector and attention survey is not repeated; R937 uses only the pinned prefix-pack point as a validity-mask comparison. report_reviews.applicable_call_path: The current whole-physical component reads every physical K/V code and scale and requires all such rows initialized. In live Mode1, host KV is authoritative; whole-page resolution can copy an unwritten host tail into slots. Long layer-major prompt attention instead stages the logical prefix in m.stage, and the current typed QSA16 branch rejects Mode1. This is a source-contract result, not a live model or RESTORE result.
